LIBRARIAN_UPDATE.toast: The Librarian has been updated to [{Version}]. Click here to learn more.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.title: Librarian
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.presentation_hint: Local display and audio settings apply immediately and save automatically.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.orb_effects_hint: Orb values, lock indicators, and tooltips remain visible when effects are off.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reduced_motion_hint: Stop circle rotation, Orb bobbing, and casting gestures, and simplify other effects added by this mod.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.limit_hint: Lower this on slower computers. Extra trails are omitted.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.circle_hint: The three Orbs and front indicator remain visible when the circle is off.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.tide_block_feedback_h: Show Tide Block gains and expiration.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.wave_hint: The Waves tooltip still shows the value when this is off.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.volume_hint: Also affected by the game's master and sound-effect volume.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reset_hint: Restore mod language, display, and audio settings. Language follows the game. Unlocks, gameplay progress, and notice history are preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.progressive_hint: Unlock content as you progress in new runs. Already unlocked content is preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.all_hint: Unlock all Librarian content for this profile. Already unlocked content stays unlocked.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.export_scope: Export runtime logs and version information only. Saves and screenshots are excluded. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_hint: The mod uses the game language on first use, then saves your selection separately.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_reload_hint: Reload added or edited translation files. Missing entries use the bundled language pack.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_templates_hi: Export the bundled Chinese and English translation templates. Existing files are preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.language_save_failed: Could not save the language selection. It applies only for this session.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preferences_load_fail: Could not read settings. Defaults are in use; the original file has been preserved.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preferences_save_fail: Could not save settings. Changes apply only for this session.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.logs_unreadable: No runtime log could be read.
LIBRARIAN_UPDATE.body:
[b][gold]Subscribe to and enable both BaseLib and RitsuLib.[/gold][/b]
See Update notes for version changes.

[b][gold]QQ group: 1091648383[/gold][/b]
Current version: [gold]v{Version}[/gold]

Settings: [gold]RitsuLib[/gold] at the main menu's top-right → Librarian.

Feedback: {Email}
LIBRARIAN_REVIEW.body:
You have defeated the Architect as the Librarian for the first time. Thank you for seeing its journey through!

If you enjoyed the adventure, please consider giving the mod a positive rating on this version's Workshop page.

Current version: [gold]v{Version}[/gold]

Suggestions and bug reports:
QQ community group: {QQGroup}
{Email}
GitHub Issues: use Report an issue.
LIBRARIAN_UNLOCK.body: Unlock Librarian cards, relics, and potions as you play, or unlock them all now? This choice only affects Librarian content for the current profile.
LIBRARIAN_UNLOCK.upgradeBody: Unlock all Librarian cards, relics, and potions for this profile now? Existing progress is preserved. Other characters are unaffected.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.locked_orb_display_hi: By default, red −1 means 1 locked turn remains. When showing the Orb value, lock turns appear below it.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.replay_welcome_hint: Clear Don't show again for this version and display the notice after returning to the main menu.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.preview_review_hint: Preview after returning to the main menu. Does not record a victory or use the first reminder.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reload_presentation_h: Read your saved local options again. Unlock progress is unchanged.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.notice_queued: Welcome notice queued. Close settings and return to the main menu to view it.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.review_queued: Review preview queued. Close settings and return to the main menu to view it.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.notice_menu_required: Open RitsuLib settings from the main menu to use this button.
LIBRARIAN_MOD.name: Librarian
LIBRARIAN_MOD.description: The Librarian, an original character with 91 cards, 9 relics, and 3 potions. Includes multiplayer cards, original artwork, and custom effects.
